newsitem.title: USA: Hannibal names Harry Neer president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Hannibal names Harry Neer president/CEO.

text.p: Hannibal Ltd said on Wednesday it named Harry Neer president and chief executive.
Former acting President Harold Gregg will continue as corporate secretary and a company director, Hannibal said in a news release.
The company also said it has moved its center of operations to Houston from Phoenix.
Neer is the first permanent president of the company, which went public through a reverse merger in September 1996.
Hannibal also named Larry Hinson as its first chief financial officer and chief operating officer.
Neer will also remain as president and chief operating officer of Rockport Group Inc of Houston, where Hinson will continue to serve as chief financial officer.
Hannibal is in the business of improving national consumer health services and health-related services.
